purpose: Check and archive genuine ALFRED as-of vintage data for three US Fed official independent macro factors to inform later BTC 2012-2025 asymmetrical rise/fall testing; do not score BTC outcomes in this pilot.

inputSeries.unit: index, historic 2019/2026 rebase must be noted

inputSeries.official: Federal Reserve Board H.15 FRED derived

query: FRED official realtime_start=asOfSunday realtime_end=asOfSunday observations via encrypted FRED_API_KEY, observation_start=asOf-65d, observation_end=asOf; no leakage from later observation dates. As-of-then historic original revision status verified; publication clock intraday not certified.
expected: At least 3 numerical observations in 65-day window including last obs at least 2d older than Sunday and <=10 days stale; no FRED rate limit misinterpreted as missing data; 4wk change if a value 25–35 calendar days prior exists.
archive: 15 raw authenticated FRED API response bodies with SHA256 in R2 and parent sources check; full pilot and manifest readback SHA. Original BTC outcomes not joined or modified.
licencing: Archive only original Federal Reserve or FRED-generated series. Do not archive proprietary VIXCLS/CBOE or Moody BAA10Y/ICE OAS until rights verified. No bypass.
methodology: Positive 4w change in real yields and broad USD are hypothesized tightening; T10Y2Y low/negative and 4w flattening are stress hypotheses, not validated crash predictors. Direction and lag to be preregistered in future v8.18b before outcome test.
guard: Research only, no changes to Spot Futures NAV reserve capital P&L MASTER live Detector trade limits or executions.
